digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge (GitHub Action) / bridge-state projects mapping
propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO) that do not exist in live REB Jira Cloud.

The Reconcile Bridge scheduled GitHub Action fails on every run since 2026-08-15T02:39Z when fetcher._build_snapshot multi-project fan-out issues jql_active queries for non-existent mapped projects, causing ACLI to reject the malformed JQL with parse error.
The .bridge_state/projects.json write path violates the locked+committed+published store invariant, enabling ad-hoc git commits on the live tickets branch to corrupt the mapping without validation.

Restoration of .bridge_state/projects.json to canonical single-project state {"version": 1, "legacy_default": "REB", "projects": {}} resolves the Reconcile Bridge failures and allows rebar bridge preview to complete without JQL parse errors.
